messages:
deploy-bot: Initiating staged rollout for service=redwood-inference-api v2.14 -> v2.15, initial canary=10% across us-west, eu-west. Release notes: https://internal/release/2.15 :sparkles:
lina: heads-up: change-window assigned 02:00-02:30 UTC. tagging infra for gpu cluster visibility.
raj: saw a few memory OOMs on gpu-3 in us-west about +3m into canary. snapshots: https://logs/gpu-ooms?since=10m
emily: Confirming. Replica set us-west-a had 2 oom kills, pod restarts and degraded throughput. Not widespread but enough to flag.
infra_jp: Can we soft-fail the us-west subset and keep the rest of the canary? Need to avoid global rollback if isolated.
neil: We support route-level exclusions. We can carve out us-west and leave 10% on other regions. Who will run the exclusion?
lina: I'll run it. Will also lower max_inflight to 30 on us-west to reduce pressure.
lina: Command I'll run: ```
# exclude us-west from canary and lower concurrency
deployctl rollout exclude-region --service redwood-inference-api --region us-west --reason "gpu OOMs" --now
deployctl config set --service redwood-inference-api --region us-west --max_inflight 30
```
deploy-bot: Pending action: exclude-region (us-west) requested by lina at 1701240012. Approval required from 1 owner.
raj: approved.
deploy-bot: Action executed: region excluded (us-west). Max_inflight updated for us-west=30.
emily: After exclusion, error rate in us-west dropped to baseline but we still see elevated memory pressure in logs.
infra_jp: I'll collect dmesg and GPU driver logs, and trigger a node drain if a node shows repeated OOMs.
neil: For audit, recording rollback command for region only: `deployctl rollback --service redwood-inference-api --version v2.14 --scope region:us-west`
lina: noting that we won't advance the canary until infra confirms no hardware/kernel regression. Please hold automated increments.
deploy-bot: Automated canary increments paused at 1701240035 by system due to regional exclusion. Current global canary remains 10% but us-west traffic excluded.
emily: I'll open an incident and add a short blurb in release notes: "Known issue: potential GPU memory pressure in us-west during v2.15 canary; us-west excluded pending investigation."
raj: Also tagging @hardware-team for follow-up.
infra_jp: If hardware clears, we can re-include us-west via `deployctl rollout include-region --service redwood-inference-api --region us-west --version v2.15` — requires owner approval.
lina: thanks everyone. scheduling postmortem if needed. closing this thread — will post updates in #incidents when nodes are validated. :white_check_mark:
